title.description: Reserved for the brain-authored run title; empty until brain stores it.

app.description: Reserved for the worker-app key; empty until brain stores it.

model.description: Reserved for the lead/worker split; `"worker"` as the safe default.

costUsd.description: Per-run token spend in USD; `0` until proxy metering writes `usage_events`.

tokens.description: Per-run token count; `0` for the same reason.

brief.description: First work-item brief (raw jsonb string); empty when the run has no work items yet.

label.description: Brain-authored step name; empty when not provided.

dependsOn.description: Ids of prerequisite work items (joined from `work_item_dependencies`).

cost.description: Reserved per-item spend in USD; `0` until usage_events is wired.

tokens.description: Reserved per-item token count; `0` for the same reason.

startedAt.description: First transition away from `Queued`, or `null` while still queued.

items.description: Wire row for one work-item in the run's plan.

workItems.description: Plan nodes, with their `dependsOn` lists joined from `work_item_dependencies`.

workItemId.description: Work-item the entry is about, when the payload carries one.

payloadJson.description: Raw payload JSON, or null when omitted.

items.description: Wire row for one journal event in the run timeline (newest first).

events.description: Recent journal rows (top 20, newest first) — run-status, work-item-status, lease-reaper, etc.

rules.description: Control-plane rule names applied; empty until control-plane exposes the lookup.

revision.description: Pinned SDK + control-plane revisions (image digest + profiles git ref).

rules.description: Git ref of the control-plane / profiles repo (pinned on the work item).

sdk.description: Worker image + digest (pinned on the work item).

description:
Full wire shape of one run for `GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}`. Carries
everything the FE `RunDetail` mapper needs without a second round-trip.

Several fields (Title, App, Model, CostUsd, Tokens, Rules) are placeholders
for data the platform does not yet store on the run row — see
GetRunDetailHandler for what is and is not populated, and
audit-report §2.7 for the broader metering / plan-extent gaps.
